proves.claim: the item panel draws one Timeline strip whose segment widths match the bucket shares within 1%, with the UNACCOUNTED stretch marked and the longest gap labelled with its reason.

view.item.timeline-strip.why: The timeline was only in the CLI; the item page shows where an item's time went at a glance.

proves.claim: the view's read-only item timeline route on a real fixture board answers the same json as pullboard timeline <id> --json.

view.item.timeline-strip-route.why: A strip drawn from a different document than the CLI prints would disagree with it.

proves.claim: each strip segment carries its stage, length and reason as title text, and the strip rules add no colour literal and use only defined tokens.

view.item.timeline-strip-hover.why: The strip must be readable without new colours and explain every segment on hover.
